title: Gaussian gradient length
statement: For a natural number $n$, a function $f:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and $x\in\mathbb{R}^n$, define the gradient length at $x$ to be $\left(\sum_{i=1}^n (Df(x)[e_i])^2\right)^{1/2}$, where $e_i$ is the $i$th coordinate vector and $Df(x)$ is the Fréchet derivative.
